kernels.name: bias_gelu
kernels.title: Bias + exact GELU
kernels.note: The bias block never changes, so it is copied once (and the TPU lowering single-buffers it).

kernels.name: softmax
kernels.title: Fused softmax (attention scores, all heads)
kernels.note: Whole rows fit in a block: one read and one write per element.

kernels.name: xent
kernels.title: Fused cross-entropy (vocabulary 65)
kernels.note: 65 columns are legal only because they are the whole row; in VMEM each row is padded to 128 lanes.

kernels.name: ln_bwd
kernels.title: LayerNorm backward
kernels.note: dscale and dbias are one block for the whole grid: it stays in VMEM, is added to at every step and written back once. That is why the axis must be "arbitrary".

kernels.name: flash_fwd
kernels.title: Flash attention forward (one head)
kernels.note: Blocks above the diagonal are skipped by pl.when; with the clamped map their K and V are not even copied.

kernels.name: flash_fwd
kernels.title: Flash attention forward (one head)
kernels.note: Blocks above the diagonal are skipped by pl.when; with the clamped map their K and V are not even copied.

kernels.name: flash_dkv
kernels.title: Flash attention backward: dK, dV (one head)
kernels.note: Each key block stays put while every query block streams past it.

kernels.name: flash_dq
kernels.title: Flash attention backward: dQ (one head)
kernels.note: The same loop as the forward. The production kernel splits the backward the same way: _flash_attention_bwd_dkv, then _flash_attention_bwd_dq.

kernels.name: paged
kernels.title: Paged decode attention (scalar prefetch)
kernels.note: The page table and lengths arrive in SMEM before the grid starts (num_scalar_prefetch=2); the index map reads them.

kernels.name: paged
kernels.title: Paged decode attention (scalar prefetch)
kernels.note: The page table and lengths arrive in SMEM before the grid starts (num_scalar_prefetch=2); the index map reads them.
